entities.summary: The Constitution of the Year III was the constitution of the French First Republic that established the Directory. It was adopted by the convention on 5 Fructidor Year III and approved by plebiscite on 6 September. Its preamble is the Declaration of the Rights and Duties of Man and of the Citizen of 1789.
